name: Wheeler Woodworks LLC
old_description: Delivering High-end, Handcrafted Custom Cabinetry To Middle Tennessee
about:
Wheeler Woodworks LLC is based in Ethridge, Tennessee. Founded in 2020 by James Wheeler, the company emerged from the Amish cabinetry shops of Ethridge where Wheeler learned high-end woodworking and a deep respect for craftsmanship. The business remains owner-operated.

The shop produces custom cabinetry and provides finish carpentry services, focusing on quality, detail, and timeless design. Operations are centered on handcrafted woodworking for residential projects; specific facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not disclosed.

The company serves homeowners and remodeling contractors throughout Middle Tennessee. A client testimonial references a remodel timeline and construction schedule, indicating collaboration with builders and direct homeowner engagement for built-in shelving and cabinetry.

Wheeler Woodworks was started to bring clients' visions to life and serve as a trusted partner in creating dream homes, emphasizing craftsmanship learned from Amish traditions.
